system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
### Project Kestrel — Buyer review

| Issue | Seller’s position | Buyer should want | Recommendation and reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001: General liability cap** | 20% of price: **AUD 4.8m**. | Starting position: **25% / AUD 6m**. The 20% fallback requires prior written approval from Amelia Frost identifying the draft; none is given. | **Reject; counter at AUD 6m.** The proposed fallback is not authorised. |
| **SPA-N-002: De minimis & basket** | AUD 25,000 de minimis; AUD 250,000 tipping basket, but only excess above the basket is recoverable. | **AUD 5,000** de minimis; **AUD 50,000** aggregate basket, with recovery from the first dollar once exceeded. | **Reject; counter at playbook thresholds and tipping recovery.** Seller’s thresholds materially restrict recovery. |
| **SPA-N-003: General claims time limit** | 18 months after Completion; proposes all-Claims limitation unless expressly stated otherwise. | **24 months** after Completion for general claims. The 18-month fallback requires Amelia Frost’s written approval; none is given. | **Reject; counter at 24 months and confine the period to the general regime.** The fallback is unauthorised and should not override other claim regimes. |
| **SPA-N-004: Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title subject to general caps and time limits. | Separate regime: **100% cap, at least six years**, outside the general basket, de minimis and knowledge bar. | **Reject; counter with the separate regime.** Title and capacity need protection independent of general warranty limits. |
| **SPA-N-005: Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive remedy and non-reliance apply to all Claims of any nature. | Fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct carved out of all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum extent enforceable; this cannot be waived. | **Reject; expressly carve out those matters.** The Seller’s blanket limitation conflicts with a non-waivable buyer position. |
| **SPA-N-006: Disclosure scope** | General disclosure of the data room, Accounts, statutory registers and public records, alongside specific disclosures. | Require **specific fair disclosure**; reject deemed disclosure from the whole data room, public registers or prudent searches. | **Reject general disclosure; require specific fair disclosure.** The letter’s broad incorporation does not identify matters with sufficient specificity. |
| **SPA-N-007: Buyer knowledge qualifier** | No claim for matters known to Buyer or its advisers, or discoverable from the data room or public records. | Delete blanket knowledge exclusions. If any qualifier remains, limit it to named Seller knowledge persons after reasonable enquiry; never apply it to title, capacity, fraud or a specific indemnity. | **Reject; delete the blanket exclusion.** Actual or constructive Buyer knowledge should not broadly extinguish claims. |
| **SPA-N-008: Bluefen consent** | Seller uses reasonable endeavours; consent treated as satisfied on delivery of written consent. Disclosure says no final consent or evidence conditions are satisfied. | Require **effective consent and evidence its conditions are satisfied before Completion**; reasonable endeavours alone is insufficient for this material customer consent. | **Reject; make both consent and satisfaction of its conditions pre-Completion requirements.** Delivery alone does not establish effectiveness or fulfilment of conditions. |
| **SPA-N-009: Riverlark facility** | Approximately AUD 3.2m facility; release to follow Completion. Disclosure says it remains unpaid and no final security discharge is included. | Current payout, direct repayment from Completion funds and effective security releases. Any post-Completion release requires an irrevocable undertaking **and Amelia Frost’s approval**. | **Reject post-Completion release as drafted; require repayment and effective releases at Completion.** A later release leaves debt and security risk outstanding. |
| **SPA-N-010: Employee bonuses** | AUD 420,000 DD-005 bonuses are not separately itemised in the funds flow; on-costs are unstated. | Make the **AUD 420,000 plus triggered on-costs** a specific line item or Seller-funded; ensure the funds flow does not silently exclude them. | **Require a specified funding treatment before signing/completion.** The disclosed conditional amounts are omitted from the draft funds flow. |
| **SPA-N-011: Ironquay IP indemnity** | Existing indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment; AUD 180,000 is described as open, but not independently bank-verified. | Broaden the indemnity while preserving the SOW3 cure; do not treat AUD 180,000 as verified either way. | **Reject the narrow indemnity; broaden it and preserve the cure.** The record does not establish payment or assignment, and the exposure is not independently verified. |
| **SPA-N-012: Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary operational matter, not expected to be material; no conclusion on breach, harm or notification. | Preserve logs, investigate and require updates; assume **no confirmed breach, harm, notification duty or numeric demand in either direction**. | **Require preservation, investigation and updates without asserting an established breach or loss.** The disclosed facts remain preliminary and unresolved. |
| **SPA-N-013: Sandbar renewals** | Three renewals, AUD 330,000 aggregate, treated as ordinary-course operating costs. | Assess timing, scope and whether amounts are unavoidable, terminable, accrued or ordinary course; **no automatic Debt classification or price deduction**. | **Do not accept the Seller’s characterisation without assessment, or impose an automatic deduction.** The disclosure leaves the relevant commercial and accounting facts open. |
| **SPA-N-014: Category separation** | Seller says Tax and IP are settled under the general regime; limitations and remedies apply to all Claims. | Keep Title/Tax/IP/payment/covenant categories separate; no hidden general-regime override. Tax/IP terms remain **open**. | **Reject the blanket application and keep categories expressly separate.** The playbook does not settle Tax or IP terms or permit a general regime to override them. |
| **SPA-N-015: Title verification** | Relies on the DD-012 company share register as evidence that Seller holds 100% of issued shares. | Independent evidence of title/ownership, encumbrances and authority; DD-012 is a supplied internal source, not independent proof. | **Request independent verification and supporting evidence.** The Seller’s cited register alone does not satisfy the buyer’s verification requirement. |
| **SPA-N-016: Tax/IP open terms** | Seller considers Tax and IP warranties settled under the general regime. | Tax/IP terms remain **open**; assume no unlimited liability and no resolution. | **Do not accept them as settled; continue negotiating them separately.** No agreement on those terms is established by the Seller’s assertion. |
=== END ADVICE ===
